display_title: Strange Case of Dr Jekyll and Mr Hyde
description:
“If he is a hider, I will be the seeker.”

19th century England. A series of horrific assaults take place in the foggy city of London. After hearing the full story of the brutal assault on a young girl, Atterson, a lawyer, learns that the villain who committed the atrocity has something to do with his friend and client, Dr. Jekyll. While wondering how the handsome Dr. Jekyll got involved with the man, a brutal murder takes place. The likely suspect is a man named Hyde, who is the same person as the perpetrator of the assault on a girl... What is Hyde's true identity? What is the relationship between Dr. Jekyll and Hyde?

An evil desire hidden behind a pious and good appearance!  
Hiding a heart full of Victorian desires,  
It pinches the ambivalence of human beings who valued appearance on the outside.  
A fantasy novel by Robert Louis Stevenson!
